title: OutLobbySpawn
description: 🔄 Automatic respawn to lobby /spawn from any set world. Simple, lightweight, and just works!
body:
![1](https://img.shields.io/badge/Paper-1.21.11-blue?style=flat-square)
![2](https://img.shields.io/badge/bStats-Plugin-ff69b4?style=flat-square)



<details>
<summary>✨ Features</summary>

- Automatic Respawn — players always spawn in the lobby after death
- Multiworld Support — works with any number of worlds
- Lightweight & Fast — minimal impact on server performance
- Simple Configuration — just one command to set the spawn
- bStats Integration — anonymous data collection for plugin improvement

</details>



<details>
<summary>🔧 How It Works</summary>

- Set the spawn on config lobby location
- Save & persist — the location is automatically saved to config
- Automatic respawn — when any player dies in any world, they respawn at the lobby world
- Works across restarts — configuration persists through server restarts

</details>



<details>
<summary>📊 bStats</summary>


- This plugin uses bStats to collect anonymous usage statistics. The data helps improve the plugin and understand how it's being used.

What's collected:
- Plugin version
- Server version
- Number of worlds
- Online mode status
- Lobby world name (anonymized)
- View plugin statistics on bStats.org

</details>







Configuration 📁
The plugin automatically creates a config.yml file:


```
# The world where players will respawn
lobby-world: "world"

# Spawn coordinates
spawn:
  x: 0.5
  y: 64.0
  z: 0.5
  yaw: 0.0
  pitch: 0.0
```
